name: checkbox
summary: A choice a person checks or unchecks, its box and its words one control: unchecked, checked and mixed, read-only, disabled, and invalid in a field with its error.

notCovered.name: ui-checkbox-indicator
notCovered.why: UI SDK draws its mark as a masked box, and a mask on the page changes how the hosted browser draws text elsewhere on it; the stage holds none, and the mark is the control's own ::after.

notCovered.name: a checkbox group
notCovered.why: UI SDK's ui-checkbox-group and its parent checkbox keep one list of values over several boxes and draw nothing of their own; each box in one is the ui-checkbox shown here, and the stage holds no group.
